Researchers have established that any graph whose edge set consists of a union of r forests can achieve a list packing number of at most 2^r, thereby allowing for k disjoint proper L-colourings when k is greater than or equal to 2^r. Notably, the findings enhance previous results regarding triangle-free planar graphs and K_5-minor-free graphs, confirming their list-packing numbers and providing new insights for combinatorial and discrete mathematics.

 - Every graph with an edge set as the union of r forests has a list packing number of at most 2^r.
 - Triangle-free planar graphs have an optimal list packing number of at most 4.
 - K_5-minor-free graphs confirm a list packing number of at most 8, matching existing results.

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.24832
